slides.sub: 8 nights out · LA, Orange County, San Diego
slides.pip: Four of the eight are free to watch.

slides.label: Mon Nov 16 · Los Angeles
slides.dates: 25th tree lighting · free · space is limited
pips: Tree lighting, first snowfall, drone show, fireworks, Santa.
It's filmed for TV, so expect a crowd.

slides.label: Dec 4 and 5 · San Diego
slides.dates: Fri 4 to 10 PM · Sat noon to 10 PM · free
pips: San Diego's biggest free holiday festival.
Saturday starts at noon: easier with little ones.

slides.label: Sundays Dec 13 and 20 · San Diego
slides.dates: 5:30 PM · about 80 lit boats · free to watch
pips: More than 100,000 people line the bay: go early.

slides.label: Dec 16 to 20 · Newport Beach
pips: Watch free from Marina Park, which has a playground.
Opening night, Dec 16: fireworks off the pier at about 6:15.

slides.label: Kids will love
items: Ice Age giants in lights, a carousel, a skating rink (extra ticket)
A new laser show with a 'snowfall' finale
Acrobatic elves, and a little 'snow' at the finale
slides.pip: Sensory-inclusive Zoo Lights night: Tue Dec 8.

items: L.A. Zoo Lights is closed some nights, including Dec 24, 25 and 31.
Jungle Bells skips Dec 24, and Dec 18 is for members only.
The Bay Parade of Lights is just two Sundays: Dec 13 and 20.

sources: The Grove: 25th Annual Christmas at The Grove, Nov 16, 2026: tree lighting, the season's first snowfall, drone show, fireworks, Santa's arrival; complimentary and open to the public; filmed for broadcast; space is limited

L.A. Zoo Lights 2026: select evenings Nov 20 to Jan 10; closed Nov 26, 30, Dec 1, 7, 14, 15, 16, 24, 25, 31 and Jan 4-7; box office 5:45-8:45 PM; ticketed; 2026 theme with Ice Age giants, birds, butterflies; artificial ice rink (separate ticket); carousel; Santa on select days (extra fee); Sensory-Inclusive night Dec 8; free parking
Descanso Gardens: Enchanted, Nov 22 to Jan 9; tenth season; new laser light show with a 'snowfall' finale; Giant Koi; timed or Anytime tickets; Holiday Market Dec 2-6
City of San Diego: Balboa Park December Nights, Fri Dec 4, 2026, 4-10 PM and Sat Dec 5, noon-10 PM; the city's largest free holiday festival; family friendly
Marina del Rey Holiday Boat Parade: 64th annual, Saturday Dec 12, 2026; theme 'Hollywood Under The Stars'; begins with a light show (no start time posted on Nov 10)

San Diego Bay Parade of Lights: 56th annual, Dec 13 and Dec 20, 2026; procession starts 5:30 PM; about 80 decorated boats; more than 100,000 people on the shores each year; no cost to view; theme 'Liberty Lights the Bay - Cheers to 250 Years'

118th Newport Beach Christmas Boat Parade: Wed-Sun Dec 16-20, 2026, about 6:30 PM nightly from the tip of Lido Isle; Marina Park (1600 W Balboa Blvd) is the largest public viewing area, free, with a nautical-themed playground; opening fireworks off Newport Pier Dec 16 at about 6:15 PM

San Diego Zoo Jungle Bells: member preview Dec 18; Dec 19, 2026 to Jan 3, 2027, excluding Dec 24; lights until 8 PM; included with all admission tickets and memberships; acrobatic elves show; a cappella finale with a dusting of 'snow'
